title: StreamPeerBuffer.data_array.append_array() does nothing
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.stable.official

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS (Focal Fossa) on X11 - X11 display driver, Single-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 (nvidia; 470.256.02) - AMD FX(tm)-8350 Eight-Core Processor (8 threads)

### Issue description

I'm using 4.4 stable official, and using StreamPeerBuffer to accumulate data. However, appending an array to StreamPeerBuffer.data_array does not work. The data to be appended does not appear in data_array, and the size of data_array does not change. Here is a snippet of code demonstrating the problem:

```
var m_bufferIn : StreamPeerBuffer
.
.
.
```
aData in the code block below is a parameter defined as:

aData : PackedByteArray
```
m_bufferIn = StreamPeerBuffer.new() #Just for debugging
print("Buffer before append " + str(m_bufferIn.data_array.size()))
print("Bytes to append " + str(aData.size()))
m_bufferIn.data_array.append_array(aData)
print("Buffer after append " + str(m_bufferIn.data_array.size()))

```

The output is:

```
Buffer before append 0
Bytes to append 164
Buffer after append 0
```

The expected behavior is for StreamPeerBuffer.data_array to be 164 bytes long and to contain the data appended from aData.


### Steps to reproduce

See above.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

See code snippet above.
